name: Asakura Natsuki
source: One of the Terrible Trio. She acts like a spoiled bitch. She's condescending, mean, and always enjoys having the upper-hand over someone. She'll go off in a heartbeat if things aren't going her way. This is incredibly unfortunate because Natsuki is also ultra-competitive. She won't give up at anything until she comes out on top, which can get her in loads of trouble.
